title: Attack on the Riemann Hypothesis II
content: Let $ \xi(z) $ be the Riemann xi function. In a previous paper we prove the boundedness of coefficients of the power series expansion of $ \xi'(1/z)/\xi(1/z) $ and thus give a proof of the Riemann hypothesis. In this paper we generalize the method there to the study of the extended Riemann hypothesis for general number fields.
